subject: Billing cadence and credit cap for FleetOps pilot
messages:
From: Anna Kowalski <anna@fleetops.com>
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@fleetops.com
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Pilot billing cadence + credit request

Hi Tessa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the FleetOps team is excited to move the pilot into production next month. A couple of finance items came up on our side that I wanted to align on before we start.

1) We typically operate on Net45 for platform vendors. For the next 90 days can we set Net45 on invoices?
2) For the initial usage surge we expect up to ~500k EUR in consumption. Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide a temporary consumption cap / credit line while invoices are processed?
3) We are an EU-registered company and will need VAT-broken down invoices and a copy of Redwood's VAT registration.

I attached our PO draft. Happy to hop on a short call if it helps.

Best,
Anna Kowalski
Head of Platform Ops | FleetOps
anna@fleetops.com

Attachments: FleetOps_PO_9876.pdf

From: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
To: Anna Kowalski <anna@fleetops.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 11:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot billing cadence + credit request

Hi Anna —

Really appreciate the note and the PO. High-level options from our side that should move quickly:

- Option A (preferred): Net45 for the pilot plus a temporary consumption cap set at 600,000 EUR for 60 days. We require PO + signed SOW and a single upfront retainer invoice equal to one month of estimated run-rate (approximately 100k EUR) to enable the cap.
- Option B: Net30 with no cap and accelerated dispute windows (used by a lot of our smaller pilots).
- Option C: Net60 with a 30% prepayment (conservative route — slower to approve).

We can provide VAT-broken invoices and our VAT registration — I'll attach the template invoice we use and ask Finance to confirm the retainer/invoice workflow. If FleetOps is fine with Option A we'll issue the retainer invoice as soon as we have the signed SOW and PO.

Next steps: confirm preferred option and upload PO + signed SOW. I can loop in Legal if you want alternate payment language.

Cheers,
Tessa Morgan
Head of Sales, Enterprise | Redwood Inference
T: +1 415 555 0198

Attachments: RI_invoice_template-v2.xlsx

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 08:27:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Pilot billing cadence + credit request

Tessa —

From Finance: we can do the temporary cap but need three things before enabling it:
1) Executed PO and SOW (scanned PDF).
2) Completed credit form (one-page) + basic reference check (I can run).
3) For EU VAT handling: we require FleetOps' VAT ID and we will mark invoices with VAT separated by country and include our VAT reg number.

Operational notes: the retainer will be invoiced Net45 but must be cleared (or booked) before we lift the cap. We'll set an internal review at 30 days to reassess the cap and consumption patterns.

I attached the credit form and the standard invoice template with VAT line items.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Finance Operations | Redwood Inference

Attachments: credit_line_request-form.pdf, RI_invoice_template-v2.xlsx

From: procurement@fleetops.com
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
Cc: Anna Kowalski <anna@fleetops.com>, Luke Harper <luke.harper@fleetops.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 10:03:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Pilot billing cadence + credit request

Hi Tessa / Marissa —

Thanks for the options. FleetOps is comfortable with Option A (Net45 + 600,000 EUR temporary cap) provided the following are included:

- The cap can be reduced/increased by mutual written agreement (email is fine).
- We receive VAT-broken invoices (country-level VAT lines).
- Delivery of the PO (attached) and FleetOps can provide VAT certificate for cross-check.
- We prefer invoices to be issued in EUR to avoid FX noise.

Attached: signed PO (FleetOps_PO_9876.pdf) and FleetOps VAT certificate. Please send the retainer invoice and the credit form — we'll get the finance team to complete the credit form promptly.

Thanks,
Procurement Team | FleetOps
procurement@fleetops.com

Attachments: FleetOps_PO_9876_signed.pdf, FleetOps_VAT_certificate.pdf

From: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
To: procurement@fleetops.com, Anna Kowalski <anna@fleetops.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 09:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot billing cadence + credit request

Thanks — received the signed PO and VAT certificate. Marissa / Finance will kick off the credit check; Marissa, please confirm ETA for the check and I'll prepare the retainer invoice.

Marissa: per procurement request, we'll:
- Issue invoices in EUR, VAT separated by country; Redwood VAT reg number will be on every invoice.
- Set temporary consumption cap at 600,000 EUR for 60 days from invoice date; internal 30-day review.
- Require PO + signed SOW + completed credit form to lift the cap.

Ben: can your team provision billing tags so FleetOps' invoices show project code FLEET-PILOT? Also please upload the RI_invoice_template-v2.xlsx to the shared drive link so Procurement has the exact column layout.

Anna: once credit form is returned and retainer invoice is paid/booked, we will lift the cap and begin standard usage invoicing. Expect the retainer invoice to be Net45 per our billing policy but we will mark the account with the temporary cap on our side immediately after retainer is recorded.

Best,
Tessa

Attachments: none
